sources.title: KCCS confirms ZED Ishikari operation in DCC announcement
sources.summary: KCCS explicitly states that it operates the named ZED Ishikari data center in Ishikari and has done so since October 2024.
sources.date_semantics: July 28 is publication of a present-tense operating confirmation, not the opening date. Status evidence is acceptable at campus scope; geometry remains unresolved.

sources.title: KCCS opens Zero Emission Data Center Ishikari
sources.summary: Operator announces opening of ZED Ishikari on October 1, 2024, with about 400 racks and receiving capacity of 2–3 MW.
sources.date_semantics: Explicit opening day is historical identity context. It is not used as the fresh admission observation. Receiving capacity is not IT load.

sources.title: KCCS ZED Ishikari campus profile
sources.summary: Names ZED Ishikari in Ishikari Bay New Port region; describes its services, 15,000 m² site and approximately 5,300 m² floor area.
sources.date_semantics: Undated profile supplies identity and scope, not a retrieval-day status observation or exact site point.

sources.title: KCCS SBT emissions announcement
sources.summary: Group emissions and SBT achievements do not provide a new named-campus physical operating observation.
sources.date_semantics: September 17 is group announcement publication, not a ZED status refresh.

sources.title: Taisei design record for ZED Ishikari
sources.summary: Designer names ZED Ishikari and its Ishikari location. West-exterior photos and cooling section show the distinctive five-box building.
sources.date_semantics: 2024 is the project year; exact webpage publication day is not established. No current physical-state date or numeric property location is inferred.

sources.title: Architect-supplied ZED Ishikari design description and plans
sources.summary: Article attributes its description to the architects and names Taisei Design, client Kyocera Communication Systems, Ishikari and the 2024 project. Gallery contains a site/roof plan and regional energy diagram.
sources.date_semantics: Historical design material used only for property-identity research. It does not supply fresh operating status.
sources.research_authority_note: Third-party publication carrying architect-supplied material; any future georeference would be compiled-reference geometry, not an official numeric point.

sources.title: ZED Ishikari site and roof plan
sources.summary: Plan shows a five-box building, a 90,200 dimension label, green space, north arrow, surrounding road edges and parking. It has no coordinate grid, street labels or parcel number. No dimensional unit conversion is selected.
sources.date_semantics: Image publication day not independently established; associated article is October 22, 2025. Plan geometry remains unanchored and no point is admitted.

sources.title: ZED design regional renewable energy diagram
sources.summary: Regional diagram outlines an assumed renewable-energy area and power sources, without a distinct data-center property marker.
sources.date_semantics: Schematic regional context only; no campus geometry or current status selected.

sources.title: Ishikari revised decarbonization proposal
sources.summary: Broad RE-zone map on page 12 and named facility descriptions on pages 13–14 establish regional context, not a specific ZED property.
sources.date_semantics: Revision context is July 4, 2025; exact online publication day is not independently established. Not a fresh status observation or cadastral record.

sources.title: ZED Ishikari historical construction location report
sources.summary: Report places ZED Ishikari along Minato-dori in Shinko-Chuo 1-chome, identifies Taisei and includes a construction-site photograph.
sources.date_semantics: Historical construction report is location research only; it does not refresh 2026 status.
sources.research_authority_note: Secondary reporting; road/address context does not establish the exact host property.

sources.title: Former Shinko-Chuo 1-chome bus stop with ZED construction in background
sources.summary: Photo caption identifies the background building as ZED construction; text places the former bus stop near Sun Village Ishikari along Minato-dori.
sources.date_semantics: Historical photograph and road context only; no photo-based 2026 construction or operating assertion is made.
sources.research_authority_note: Secondary reporting; perspective is insufficient to select a unique property point.

sources.title: Ishikari city NTT ME container data center project page
sources.summary: Page reports a May 18 groundbreaking ceremony, planned June 2026 first-container construction and operation as early as February 2027.
sources.date_semantics: June 2 is page update. May 18 is a ceremony, June is a target month, and February 2027 is an opening target. None proves achieved physical work in the admission window.

sources.title: Hokkaido GX tax-plan recognition names NTT ME Ishikari project land
sources.summary: Page 2, recognition number 5, names NTT ME container data center business at Ishikari-shi Shinko-Chuo 1-chome 728.
sources.date_semantics: January 30 is business-plan recognition under the GX tax system. This is not issuance of development/building consent and does not prove construction.

sources.title: NTT ME joins Ishikari data-center consortium
sources.summary: Regional consortium announcement lists NTT ME among participants and gives a broad RE-zone aerial image. It does not name a JPDC construction milestone.
sources.date_semantics: July 28 is consortium formation announcement. Membership cannot refresh a specific project physical status or identify a common campus.

sources.title: MIRAIT ONE installs water-cooled container at Shinkiba building
sources.summary: Operator says a first commercial-model 20 ft water-cooled container was installed at its Shinkiba building for MM Advanced Innovation Lab verification. Operation was targeted for September 2026 or later.
sources.date_semantics: July 3 is an installation confirmation, 103 days before this review. It does not establish operation; September is only a target. The installed unit is explicitly a demonstration facility despite commercial-model language.

sources.title: MIRAIT ONE launches container-data-center video program
sources.summary: Announces a corporate technology video released September 11 about container data centers. Text does not establish achieved operation of the specific Shinkiba demonstration unit.
sources.date_semantics: September 14 is the announcement date and September 11 the program publication date; neither is an opening or independently dated on-site observation. Video content remains unreviewed.
